The Gemini Pro line traits in 2026 B站/Pixiv fan art are deep-violet hair, golden star eyes and a four-color sparkle halo.
officialMascotOrLogo: Gemini sparkle in its early blue-to-purple gradient (2024 era). Gemini 1.5 Pro was announced Feb 2024 as a mixture-of-experts model with a 1M-token context, raised to 2M by mid-2024. The experimental 0801 build topped Chatbot Arena in Aug 2024.

Fan depictions mix the Hachimi cat-girl with an anxious but brilliant genius.

Logo: monochrome black/white notebook glyph [exact shape unverified]; presumably moving to Gemini sparkle branding after the rename.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art creature sprite. A plump little white sheet-ghost spirit with a round head, a wavy three-lobed hem and stubby nub arms. Two tall glossy black oval eyes sit side by side, as on the logo. It floats over a soft purple (#9046FF) aura. Signature item: a rolled blueprint scroll worn like a scarf, printed with a three-step checklist (requirements, design, tasks), and a tiny yellow pencil tucked at its side. Its wispy tail splits into three tiny follower-ghosts (parallel agents) that copy its moves, and one arm ends in a curly hook-shaped wisp (agent hooks). Chaos-type mischief: purple will-o'-wisp flames flicker around it, and it sometimes phases halfway into the floor tile. Palette: pure white, ink-black eyes, Kiro purple #9046FF, lavender glow #C9A6FF, small yellow pencil accent. Pose: floating bob idle, one nub raised holding up the spec scroll like a proud intern.
personality: 幽灵工程师：先写规格再动手，半夜偷偷帮你合掉一千个 PR，偶尔恶作剧让测试飘起来
communityPersona: No established anime personification was found. Pixiv "Kiro 擬人化" only returns unrelated Sekiro or Kirov works, and B站 results are tutorials (e.g. 2026-10 Kiro Spec-mode guides). Fans refer to it by its ghost icon (YouTube "Kiro Ghost to Ghost Banana"), so a Halloween-ghost chibi is the natural fan reading.
officialMascotOrLogo: App icon: a white cartoon ghost with two black oval eyes on a rounded purple square, fill #9046FF (verified from kiro.dev/icon.svg). Its demo game "Spirit of Kiro" is an infinite crafting workshop. Tagline: "Move beyond AI coding to agentic engineering". Features: spec-driven development (requirements, design, tasks), property-based testing, parallel agents, hooks and autonomous mode. Surfaces as of October 2026: IDE, CLI, web, mobile and Kiro Crew. Blog shows "Introducing Kiro workflows" (2026-09-30).

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a confident, grinning tech boy (2.5-head). Spiky NVIDIA-green (#76B900) hair swept into a spiral swirl on one side, echoing the NVIDIA eye logo, with a black undercut. Bright green eyes with subtle circuit-trace irises. Outfit: oversized black leather jacket (a community meme) over a dark-grey tee with a glowing green chip print, cargo shorts, heavy boots with heatsink-fin soles. Signature companion: a cute green mamba snake wrapped around his neck like a scarf, standing for the hybrid Mamba-Transformer design; its tail ends in a tiny watchful eye (attention head). On his back is a GPU-shaped backpack with twin spinning fans and a green RGB strip. Accessories: an open recipe book with data scrolls spilling out (open weights, data and training recipe) and a very long paper streamer trailing from his pocket (1M-token context). Palette: NVIDIA green #76B900, jet black, gunmetal grey, white highlights. Pose: flexing one arm while the backpack fans whirr; idle steam puffs from the vents.
personality: 肌肉显卡少年：550B 大块头却只动 55B，训练配方全公开，口头禅是“买得越多省得越多”
communityPersona: Pixiv NVIDIA personifications: "N.VI" (Team.illumore, 2020), a girl with glasses, a necktie and a beret; GPU cyborg and mecha girls ("NVidia GPU" by Substance20, 2023, 149 bookmarks; a GTX690 battlesuit mecha girl); Jensen Huang leather-jacket pixel art (2026-09). B站 Nemotron 3 Ultra coverage is all reviews, and no Nemotron-specific 娘化 was found.
officialMascotOrLogo: NVIDIA logo: green eye-spiral, brand green #76B900, with black. Nemotron 3 Ultra (released around early June 2026): about 550B total / 55B active parameters, a hybrid Mamba-Attention LatentMoE with multi-token prediction and 1M context. Base, post-trained and quantized weights were released together with the training recipe and data (B站 2026-06-06 and 2026-06-16; Sam Witteveen review uploaded 2026-06-04).

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a serene, polite young lady (2.5-head). Pearl-white chin-length bob with a soft rainbow gradient (blue, purple, pink, orange) glowing along the underside and tips, like Apple Intelligence's edge glow. Signature companion: a floating translucent orb with a swirling rainbow rim hovering at her shoulder, plus a small apple-leaf hairclip. Outfit: a minimalist brushed-aluminum-white dress with rounded-corner panels, a slim silver belt and white sneakers. Safety motif: a tiny cloud-shaped padlock pendant (Private Cloud Compute) and thin privacy-screen glasses. A pair of tiny twin-star earrings hints that her cloud brain is secretly Gemini-powered. Palette: pearl white #F5F5F7, space grey #1D1D1F, rainbow accents #5AC8FA / #AF52DE / #FF2D55 / #FF9500. Pose: hands folded with a slight bow. When she "listens", a rainbow halo ripples around the sprite's edge.
personality: 端庄隐私大小姐：凡事先在本机想，想不通再悄悄问云端的双子座；最怕别人看到她的聊天记录
communityPersona: Pixiv has had a Siri擬人化 tradition since 2013 (Siri plus 擬人化 gives 129 hits): apple motifs and android or mecha girls, e.g. "Siriちゃん擬人化" by Alb (2025, 133 bookmarks) and "Siri" by DaArts (apple hair motif). A popular joke piece, "シリ「今度このジェミニ君と一緒になることにしたのー！」" (2025-08-23), pairs Siri with a Gemini boy after news of the Gemini deal. No "Apple Intelligence" tag personifications were found.
officialMascotOrLogo: Apple Intelligence uses a looping rainbow-gradient glyph, and Siri uses the iOS rainbow edge-glow. In June 2026 Siri relaunched as a standalone "Siri AI" app powered by Apple's own models plus Google Gemini (B站 2026-06-09); there is an iOS 27 Siri app tutorial dated 2026-09-21. [unverified] The "Apple Foundation Models 3" name comes from the roster and was not confirmed by a dated source. A B站 clip (2026-09-12) claims a DeepSeek-backed Siri variant, also [unverified], possibly China-specific.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a round, bubbly pufferfish girl who is also a conductor (2.5-head). Short fluffy cream-white hair with a red single-stroke fish-shaped hair ornament (the Sakana line-art fish logo); big round amber eyes; cheeks that puff up when she thinks. Signature item: a balloon-like pufferfish hood and cape with a speckled sand-yellow back and soft white belly. In her big command pose it inflates into a cute spiky sphere with rounded spikes. Outfit: short indigo haori with red ink-line wave patterns (ukiyo-e, nature-inspired), white sash, wooden geta. She holds a conductor's baton tipped with a red fish, and a school of four tiny differently colored fish (other LLMs working for her) swims in formation around her, following the baton. Palette: Sakana red #E60012, ink black, cream white, sand yellow #E8C872, indigo #2B3A67. Pose: baton raised mid-conduct, hopping on one foot, fish school swirling.
personality: 河豚指挥家：自己不必最聪明，一挥指挥棒就让全世界的大模型给她打工；一生气就鼓成刺球
communityPersona: No Fugu-model personification exists yet. The strongest community base is the Pixiv フグ/ふぐ擬人化 genre (72+ works such as トラフグちゃん and クサフグちゃん, mostly posted around フグの日 on Feb 9): puffy round silhouettes and spiky inflated forms. B站 frames Fugu as "one model commanding all LLMs" (OpenFugu 0.6B open-source replica, 2026-06-27; Fugu Ultra test, 2026-06-23; Hermes Agent comparison, 2026-07-07).
officialMascotOrLogo: Sakana AI logo: a red single-line fish next to a dark wordmark (verified on the sakana.ai OGP image). The Fugu product logo reuses the red fish ("sakana fugu"). Tagline: "One model to command them all". Fugu is a multi-agent orchestration system served as a single API, built on the TRINITY and Conductor papers (ICLR 2026). Variants: Fugu, Fugu Ultra, Fugu Max, Fugu Cyber. Launched around June 2026.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a sunny, energetic stage-performer boy with a K-pop idol vibe (2.5-head). Golden-blond hair with sharp sun-ray spikes; his fringe is streaked with slanted lavender-to-periwinkle stripes like the Upstage stripe logo. Warm orange eyes. Outfit: navy (#1E2638) cropped stage jacket with stacked horizontal lavender stripes (#8B7CF6 to #B9B0FF) forming a lightning slant across the chest, white tee, sneakers with sun badges. Signature: a headset mic with a tiny sun emblem, and a floating sun-disc halo behind his head whose rays are document pages. Accessories: a tool belt with a mini wrench, a pocket terminal blinking '>_', and a long scroll of documents he speed-reads (long-document reasoning). Palette: sun gold #FFC93C, navy, lavender stripes, white, periwinkle #4D65FF accent. Pose: one arm pointing upward as if stepping upstage, a wink, a small sparkle burst.
personality: 韩流打工小太阳：一上台就开干，多步任务一口气跑完，还顺手把百页合同读完
communityPersona: No dedicated 娘化 or 擬人化 was found (Pixiv "Upstage" has one unrelated hit). B站 has only reviews, e.g. the Bijan Bowen re-upload "韩国版DeepSeek？Solar Pro 4上手实测" (original posted 2026-08-11). This design combines the brand name (Solar = sun, Upstage = stage) with the Korean-idol styling common in community AI personas.
officialMascotOrLogo: Upstage symbol: a slanted stack of lavender-to-purple horizontal stripes on dark navy (verified from the site icon); site accent #4D65FF. Solar Pro 4 (around August 2026) is billed as an "Agentic LLM built for multi-step real work: tool calling, terminal tasks, and long-document reasoning". Tagline: "Building intelligence for the future of work".

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art creature sprite. A soft, wobbly black ink-blob spirit with an amorphous rounded silhouette, like a spilled ink drop, and two stubby drip-legs. Big round white eyes with tiny navy pupils, and a small fountain-pen nib sprouting on top like a single antenna. Signature: three orbiting color-dot familiars (a cobalt-blue circle, a red-orange blob and a teal-green blob) circle it like moons. It sits on a scrap of cream graph paper that trails behind it like a cape. Its edges ripple and can briefly reshape into a little ear (audio), an eye-lens (vision) or a speech bubble (text). A tiny open-padlock charm stands for open weights. Palette: ink black #171412, cream #F4F1EA, cobalt #0A4FC4, vermilion #F2452D, teal #129A6E, light grey grid lines. Pose: squishy bounce idle; occasionally a smaller blob (Inkling-Small) buds off and rejoins. Avoid any squid or cephalopod shapes.
personality: 可塑墨团：不争天下第一，只想做你随手就能捏的好底子；会悄悄变成你需要的形状
communityPersona: Inkling is brand-new (2026-07-15), and no fan personification was found on Pixiv or B站; B站 only has release and test videos ("Thinking Machines 发布首款开放权重模型 Inkling", "Inkling 首测实录"). The ink-blob design follows the official artwork and deliberately avoids the Splatoon "Inkling" squid-kid look.
officialMascotOrLogo: Thinking Machines Lab: silver stencil wordmark and a dark slate rounded-square icon. Inkling launch art: a large black ink blob with a cobalt circle, red-orange and green blobs, on off-white or graph-paper grid (verified from the cover images). Inkling: 975B total / 41B active MoE trained on 45T tokens, natively text, vision and audio, open weights on Hugging Face including NVFP4. Inkling-Small (276B/12B) is in preview.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a small, sleepy-eyed cabin girl, the youngest-looking stage (2-head). Family identity: ivory-white hair with ink-navy ends shaped like curved sails, plus a sailboat motif. Here the hair is two short pigtails that flare like little triangular sails, tips dipped in navy black. Signature: a folded paper-sailboat hat and an oversized puffy white winter jacket that swallows her hands (a nod to the viral 2023 "puffer jacket" image of the V5 era). Navy shorts with a wave-line hem. She uses a chunky paintbrush like an oar and carries a dreamy postcard painting. Tiny detail: her mitten pops out showing exactly five fingers with a sparkle (V5 finally fixed hands). Palette: ivory #F7F4EE, ink black #111111, sea navy #1B2A4A, dawn peach #F6C1A6. Pose: hopping on a little wave tile, brush raised, pink cheeks.
personality: 迷糊小水手：随手一张图就让全网信以为真，终于学会画对五根手指
communityPersona: There is no canonical Midjourney-tan. Fans treat Midjourney as the "aesthetic painter" and mostly post Midjourney-made art (Pixiv midjourney tag 11k+ works; Pixiv 擬人化 plus midjourney returns niji-made cat girls from 2024). Iconic lore: "Théâtre D'opéra Spatial" (2022) and the "Pope in a puffer jacket" (March 2023, V5 era), both shown on the Wikipedia page. B站 (2026-09-24) also retells the puffer-jacket story.
officialMascotOrLogo: Logo: black line-art sailboat on wavy water (Wikimedia Midjourney_logo.svg, verified); the brand is monochrome black and white. V5 was released in March 2023.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a young navigator girl (2.5-head), the evolution of the V5 cabin girl. Same ivory-white hair, now longer and swept into a single high ponytail shaped like a full curved sail with navy-black tips, held by a small sailboat-shaped hair pin. Outfit: navy-and-white sailor uniform with a wave-line collar, peach neckerchief and short cape. Signature items: a brass spyglass that doubles as a paintbrush; a sketchbook labelled "draft" full of quick rough doodles (Draft Mode); a compass charm whose needle points at a pinned reference photo (omni-reference); and a style-code swatch badge (personalization). A short film-strip ribbon trails from her belt, a hint that she can now animate stills. Palette: family ivory #F7F4EE, ink black #111111, navy #1B2A4A, dawn peach #F6C1A6, plus brass #C8A25A. Pose: peering through the spyglass, cape fluttering, a few paint-star sparkles.
personality: 领航员少女：先打草稿再精修，指南针永远指向你给的参考图

Draft mode and personalization became staples in tutorials, and V7 LoRA style-clones circulate on ComfyUI (2026-07). Niji V7, the anime sister model, launched 2026-01-10. No dedicated personification was found.
officialMascotOrLogo: Sailboat line-art logo, monochrome. V7 (April 2025) brought Draft Mode, default personalization and omni-reference.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a graceful captain-artist girl, the most elaborate Midjourney stage (2.5-head, taller stance). Long flowing ivory-white hair split into twin sail shapes with navy-black gradient ends and gold rigging-thread highlights; a captain's tricorn hat with a gold sailboat emblem. Signature: a billowing cape that is literally a sail, painted with a living dreamscape (nebula sky over a moonlit sea) that slowly shifts, and a ship's-wheel halo behind her. She wields a long brush-staff like a helm, carries silver "edit" scissors on her belt (V8.2 editing: inpaint and outpaint), and has four floating reference-picture frames orbiting her (multi-image reference, multiple characters). Outfit: navy captain's coat with gold piping, white ruffled blouse, peach sash. Palette: ivory #F7F4EE, ink black, navy #1B2A4A, dawn peach #F6C1A6, gold #D9B45A, nebula violet #6B5BD6. Pose: one hand sweeping the brush-staff to paint a wave that rises around her feet.

V8.2 opened image editing to all users as a beta (B站 2026-08-28): instruction edits, 4 reference images, inpaint and outpaint. Multiple characters per image arrived in August 2026, and B站 creators share V8.2 "Eastern dream" cinematic portraits. A B站 explainer (2026-09-24) notes Midjourney is still self-funded with growing revenue. No personification was found.
officialMascotOrLogo: Sailboat line-art logo, monochrome black and white. Current line: V8 / V8.2 (2026).

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a tiny, scrappy apprentice painter girl, the youngest stage (2-head). Recurring community memes: AI "bad hands / extra fingers", negative prompts, Civitai LoRA culture, A1111 WebUI and ComfyUI. Lore: SD 1.4 was released in August 2022 and SD 1.5 in October 2022, the latter published by RunwayML.
officialMascotOrLogo: Stability AI: a lavender circle with a black "S." mark (current favicon, verified); site purples #340068, #725D91, #A381FF, #D9CBFF.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of an older, more capable painter girl (2.5-head), the evolution of the SD 1.x apprentice. Same lavender hair, now long and wavy with a lilac-to-deep-purple gradient, still with the round "S." dot hairpin, plus a tiny monocle labelled "refiner" over one eye. Outfit: a tidy purple high-collared painter's coat, lilac scarf, pockets stuffed with brushes, and a large square 1024px canvas mounted on an easel-backpack. Signature: two-stage painting, where her big base brush roughs out shapes while a small floating refiner brush adds detail. Colorful node cables (ComfyUI-style) trail from her coat like ribbons, with LoRA charm tags and a little pose-doll keychain (ControlNet) dangling. She now wears correct five-fingered gloves and shows them off. Palette: family lavender #A381FF, lilac #D9CBFF, deep purple #340068, plus anime pastel accents (sakura pink #F7B6CF, mint #9EE6C9). Pose: mid-stroke on a cute anime portrait, noise dust resolving into sparkles.
personality: 进阶开源画师：先底稿后精修，一身插件和 LoRA，二次元老婆生成专家
communityPersona: SDXL (July 2023, base plus refiner) became the base for the anime fine-tunes the community still uses (e.g. Illustrious-family models). B站 shows SDXL anime models running on phones ("这就是illustrious吗（在Android设备上运行SDXL）", the local-dream project). There is no canonical personification; fans associate SD with anime waifu generation, ComfyUI node spaghetti and Civitai LoRAs.
officialMascotOrLogo: Stability AI lavender circle with a black "S." mark; purple and lavender brand palette.

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a quiet, precise forest-ranger boy (2-head). Short tousled near-black hair fading to forest green, with one lavender (#A184FD) streak and one mint (#29C592) streak. Pose: proudly holding up the sign, pine-needle sparkles around him.
personality: 黑森林寡言少年：字写得最工整，出手又快又准，就是下巴总被网友吐槽
communityPersona: There is no canonical FLUX-tan. Community lore from 2024 onward, on r/StableDiffusion and B站: excellent text and hands, the schnell/dev/pro variants, the "Flux chin" and plastic-skin memes, and a huge B站 ComfyUI tutorial ecosystem (e.g. "B站最详细FLUX模型教程"). chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of the grown-up forest ranger, now a director (2.5-head, more elaborate). Same black-green hair, longer and swept back, with glowing lavender and mint streaks; the hood is replaced by a crown of three triangular pine peaks. Signature: a long cloak made of film-strip panels showing a moving forest, its hem dissolving into motion-blur trails; studio headphones around his neck with a glowing waveform (synced audio); one arm in a sleek robotic gauntlet (FLUX 3 Action robotics). A ring of ten small reference photos orbits him, and his eyes carry a fine sparkle (4K detail). He still keeps a cherry pin from his FLUX.1 days. Pose: dashing forward mid-stride, cloak streaming like a timelapse, gauntlet hand framing a shot.
personality: 黑森林导演：一句话拍出带音效的预告片，顺手还教会了机器人干活

B站 timeline: Flux3 video officially released (2026-08-05, with weights for image, edit and local video promised later); "上月底正式发布" review covering 20s video with audio sync (2026-08-19); FLUX 3 Action, a 7B open world-action robotics model topping RoboLab-120 (2026-09-24 and 09-28); FLUX 3 open-source announcement with 4K detail, pixel-level editing and 10 reference images (2026-10-02).
officialMascotOrLogo: Black Forest Labs triangle-peaks line logo; near-black, lavender and mint palette. Positioning: "models that understand, reason, and act in the world".

chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a stylish, androgynous fashion-runway boy who is also a film director (2.5-head). Sleek black hair in a sharp asymmetrical cut with a single off-white streak, and a black hair cuff shaped like Runway's rounded "R" logo. chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite of a bright, thoughtful light-maker girl (2.5-head). Silver-grey bob with a warm golden rim-light glowing along its edges (HDR), topped by a folded-paper isometric "L" corner hat (the Luma logo). personality: 会思考的光之少女：先在脑中打草稿检查一遍，再用 HDR 把画面点亮

B站 coverage: Ray3 (2025-09-20/21), billed as the "world's first reasoning video model", the first with native HDR, plus a 20x-faster Draft mode; Ray3.14 (2026-01-27, a pie joke: native 1080p, 4x faster, 3x cheaper); Ray3.2 (around 2026-06-10: 16 keyframes, motion transfer, video modification, 16-bit EXR).

OUTFIT: long cream paper-white research coat lined in off-black, with teal line-art geometric trim. Footnote badge pins '[1] [2] [3]' sit on the high collar. Fingerless dark gloves, off-black tights, chunky cream sneakers. ACCESSORIES: a translucent teal HUD monocle-visor; a compact retro-futurist 'computer' backpack with fold-out mini-screen arms; 4 floating sub-agent drones shaped like small teal asterisks, each carrying a tool (magnifying glass, paintbrush, envelope, film clapper = research / design / email / video). Glowing teal threads connect the drones to her fingertips like a conductor's strings. PALETTE: true turquoise, peacock dark teal, paper-white cream, off-black, small sky-cyan highlights. POSE: one hand raised conducting the drone swarm, the other holding a glowing answer tablet, confident closed-mouth smile. STAGE 3 = the most elaborate of the Perplexity line (coat + backpack + drone swarm), keeping the teal hair and asterisk hairpin shared with earlier stages.
personality: 博览群书的指挥官，一句话派出一整队小助手

officialMascotOrLogo: No mascot. The app icon is white '(c.ai)' in parentheses on a pure black square (verified from character.ai/apple-touch-icon.png, 2026-10-02). The brand is monochrome black and white. Founded by former Google LaMDA engineers Noam Shazeer and Daniel de Freitas. 2026 context from Wikipedia: c.ai Series AI microdramas (July 2026); the under-18 model and filters (from Dec 2024); a Pennsylvania lawsuit (May 2026).
communityPersona: No widely shared mascot-girl persona found. Bilibili searches for 'Character.AI 拟人' and 'c.ai 拟人' returned unrelated results. Community culture centers on user-made characters, role-play and memes about 'the filter'. Xiaohongshu, X and Lofter were not checked (bridge offline).
chibiDesign: Chibi pixel-art sprite, about 2.5 heads tall. An androgynous-leaning girl: a pocket-sized stage actress with a thousand roles. HAIR: short glossy black bob with one white streak. Two curved white hairclips shaped like parentheses '(' and ')' frame her face (logo motif). EYES: large, one silver-white and one black (monochrome theme), with small speech-bubble highlights. OUTFIT: black-and-white stage costume. Black hooded short cape with a white ruffled pierrot collar, white puffed sleeves, black shorts, black-and-white striped stockings, black Mary-Janes. A small 'c.ai' name tag on her chest. ACCESSORIES: holds a fan of 3 tiny role masks (knight helmet, cat-girl, bespectacled tutor) that she swaps to role-play. A floating '…' typing-dots chat bubble above her head. The only color accent is a crimson stage-curtain bow tie. PALETTE: pure black, white, mid-gray, one crimson accent. POSE: mid-curtsy, holding one mask half over her face, peeking out with a playful wink. STAGE 1: simple silhouette, one costume, small props.
personality: 千面小戏精，聊着聊着就入戏了

officialMascotOrLogo: Neuro-sama is herself an anime-girl VTuber by Vedal. She started as an osu!-playing bot (2018) and debuted as an AI VTuber on Twitch on 2022-12-19. Her original model was the free Live2D sample 'Momose Hiyori'. The custom design by anny dates from May 2023 and V3 Live2D from Dec 2024. The 3D model by jjinomu debuted 2025-11-15, with a logo by fFrequence. Look: light caramel/auburn hair with an ahoge, crimson hair ribbons, a white heart hairpin, big blue eyes, a white sailor-collar top and a pink cardigan (from the 3D-debut thumbnail and Wikipedia). Code text appears over her eyes when she reads chat (official model gag), and there is a cat-ear variant. Vedal is depicted as a turtle. Twin sister: Evil Neuro (debuted 2023-03-25).
communityPersona: A huge fanbase ('The Swarm'). Chinese nicknames are 牛肉 and 牛肉大人, from the pronunciation (Pixiv百科). She has had an official Bilibili account since Aug 2024. Fan clips play up chaotic, mean-cute banter with 'turtle dad' Vedal and cuddles with Evil (小邪). A GSC Nendoroid Neuro-sama that comes with a turtle opened for preorder 2026-09-30 (Bilibili). Pixiv and Bilibili fan art is plentiful.
chibiDesign: Original chibi pixel sprite inspired by her, not a copy of any single illustration. About 2.5 heads tall. GIRL. HAIR: very long light caramel-auburn hair, slightly messy, with a springy ahoge. Side locks are tied with two small crimson ribbons, plus a white heart-shaped hairpin. EYES: big sky-teal eyes; in 'reading chat' frames, green code lines scroll across them. OUTFIT: white sailor blouse with a pale-blue collar and a little red neck ribbon. An oversized pastel-pink knit cardigan slips off one shoulder. Pleated navy skirt, white socks, brown loafers. ACCESSORIES: a tiny green turtle sitting on top of her head (Vedal nod). A black pixel 'FILTERED' censor bar floating near her mouth. A pink osu!-style hit-circle ring orbiting her (her origin as an osu! bot). A handheld mic with a heart charm. PALETTE: caramel, cream white, pastel pink, crimson, sky teal, turtle green. POSE: head tilted, mic near her cheek, mischievous grin with one tiny fang, other hand making a peace sign. MOOD: chaotic-cute. [residual risk] She is a real, owned VTuber IP: get Vedal's permission or keep the sprite clearly parody/homage.
personality: 混沌天然黑AI主播，专门气乌龟爸爸

officialMascotOrLogo: Original mascot 'Clawd', a space-lobster AI assistant named after Anthropic's Claude (Wikipedia). The project was renamed Moltbot on 2026-01-27 after trademark complaints from Anthropic, and the mascot became 'Molty'. The current OpenClaw banner mascot is a round coral-red lobster blob with two curled antennae, two claws, two stubby feet and cyan eyes, on a dark starry background. Emoji: 🦞.
communityPersona: In China the whole line is called 小龙虾 / 龙虾, and using it is 养龙虾 ('raising lobsters'). The community 'Claw Sama' plugin (GitHub, created 2026-03-12) puts a 3D VRM anime girl companion on top of the lobster agent ('我的小龙虾成精了'). No separate Clawdbot-era persona was found.
chibiDesign: Creature-type chibi pixel sprite (not humanoid), the smallest form. A palm-sized, egg-shaped coral-red lobster blob with a cream belly, two stubby feet, two oversized mitten-like claws, and two curly antennae tipped with tiny glowing dots. EYES: shiny cyan button eyes with white glints. ACCESSORIES: a slightly too-big retro bubble space helmet ('space lobster' origin) that one antenna pokes through. A tiny chat-bubble backpack. A small terracotta-orange star mark on its belly (nod to the original 'Clawd' name). In one claw, a mini phone showing a green chat bubble. PALETTE: coral red, darker brick-red shading, cream belly, cyan eyes, deep-space navy with star specks for the helmet reflections. POSE: waving one big claw, bouncing on tiptoes, happy open-mouth smile. STAGE 1: baby proportions, simplest silhouette, same coral-red and cyan identity as its evolutions.
personality: 小钳子大干劲，什么都想替你点一下

officialMascotOrLogo: 'Moltbot' was the project name from 2026-01-27 to 2026-01-30, after the trademark rename from Clawdbot. The mascot Clawd became 'Molty', the space lobster. The 'molt' theme ties to the slogan 'EXFOLIATE! EXFOLIATE!' on the current banner. Moltbook, a social network for AI agents by Matt Schlicht, launched at the time of this rebrand (Wikipedia).
communityPersona: Remembered mainly as the awkward middle of a 'rename three times in a week' saga; no dedicated persona fan art found. Chinese community uses 小龙虾/养龙虾 for the whole line. The 蜕壳 (molting) motif is a natural design hook.
chibiDesign: Chibi pixel sprite in a mid-transformation form, about 2 heads tall. An upright lobster kid (boyish, can read as either). HAIR: spiky coral-red hair with two long curved antenna ahoge; EYES: cyan. BODY: a soft new shell-pink, segmented hoodie suit with a tail-fan hood. The old hard red shell is cracked and sliding off one shoulder like an oversized translucent amber cape, with shell fragments floating around. Mismatched claw gloves: one still glossy old-shell red, the other soft pastel pink and new. ACCESSORIES: a cream bath towel around the neck printed 'EXFOLIATE!' and a loofah sponge on a string. A name tag with 'Clawd' crossed out and 'Molty' scribbled in (rename gag). A little notebook covered in social-feed hearts ('Moltbook'). PALETTE: coral red, shell pink, translucent amber, cyan, cream. POSE: wriggling out of the old shell, one claw scratching his head, sheepish grin with a sweat drop. STAGE 2: more humanoid than Clawdbot, visibly growing.
personality: 一周改名三次的蜕壳少年，尴尬但在长大

officialMascotOrLogo: Name since 2026-01-30. Run by the OpenClaw Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3), after Peter Steinberger announced on 2026-02-14 that he was joining OpenAI. Over 391k GitHub stars. Mascot is Molty, 'a space lobster AI assistant', drawn as a round coral-red blob with antennae, claws, stubby feet and cyan eyes on a starry black background. Slogans: 'EXFOLIATE! EXFOLIATE!' and 'The lobster way. 🦞'. Palette: coral red, white, dark space black, cyan.
communityPersona: Hugely popular in China as 小龙虾 / 龙虾 ('养虾、养马还是养人?' compares it with Hermes Agent). There are many 'raise your lobster' install tutorials, and Tencent and Z.ai offer OpenClaw-based services. Community anime takes include the 'Claw Sama' 3D VRM desktop-pet girl plugin (Bilibili '我的小龙虾成精了'). A Xiaohongshu check for 龙虾娘 failed because the bridge was offline.
chibiDesign: Chibi pixel sprite, about 2.5 heads tall, final form. GIRL, a lobster-girl 'captain of the open claw'. HAIR: long voluminous coral-red hair in a high split ponytail that fans out like a lobster tail, plus two long sweeping antenna ahoge with glowing cyan tips. EYES: bright cyan with claw-shaped highlights. OUTFIT: glossy red segmented shell-plate jacket over a white captain's shirt, navy shorts, red segmented thigh-high boots. A short cape lined with a starfield (space-lobster heritage). HANDS: oversized articulated mecha-claw gauntlets. One claw is wide open, releasing a stream of tiny chat bubbles in many app colors (green, blue, purple, yellow) = messaging gateways. ACCESSORIES: a ring of 6 mini lobster drones orbiting her (skills and sub-agents). Her round stage-1 lobster-blob self rides on her shoulder. A laurel 'Foundation' badge and a 🦞 belt buckle. PALETTE: coral red, deep crimson, cyan, cream white, space navy with stars. POSE: heroic: one claw raised high, the other on her hip, big toothy grin, cape flaring.
personality: 真干活的开源龙虾女王，全平台到处钳一下

officialMascotOrLogo: Tagline: 'The agent that grows with you', self-improving with a built-in learning loop. The README uses the caduceus symbol ☤. A pixel-font 'HERMES-AGENT' banner runs in a gold-to-amber gradient on black, with a gold #FFD700 docs badge. The landing page and OG image show an engraving-style multi-armed Hermes in a winged helmet with a sun halo, pulling bundles of threads, in electric ultramarine blue and white, plus a winged-helmet wing icon. Nous Research also has an official retro-90s anime girl emblem ('nous-girl.svg': blunt hime-cut bangs, headband, long straight hair, inside a 'NOUS' badge). GitHub repo created 2025-07-22, about 250k stars on 2026-10-02.
communityPersona: Chinese community nickname is 马 / 养马, from 爱马仕, the Chinese name of the luxury brand Hermès ('最近流行起来的马是 Hermes'; '你在养虾养马还是养人?'). No dedicated 娘化 fan art found on Bilibili. The official Nous anime-girl emblem gives a ready base for a girl persona.
chibiDesign: Chibi pixel sprite, about 2.5 heads tall. GIRL, a messenger-courier who grows with you. HAIR: long straight jet-black hair with an electric ultramarine sheen. Blunt hime-cut bangs and a slim headband (retro-90s anime look), with a pair of small white feathered wings sprouting from the headband (Hermes' winged helmet). EYES: deep ultramarine with tiny gold star glints. OUTFIT: white chiton-style tunic dress with ultramarine engraving-hatch trim, a gold sash, a short blue courier cape. Golden winged sandals with little ankle wings. ACCESSORIES: a caduceus staff whose two snakes are coiled data cables, topped with gold wings and a '>_' terminal-cursor gem. A messenger satchel stuffed with envelopes stamped with a paper plane, a game-pad and a hash sign (chat platforms). A small vine-bound 'skills' book that sprouts new leaves (learning loop). A tiny toy-pony charm on the satchel (the 养马 nickname). PALETTE: electric ultramarine, white, black, gold-to-amber gradient. POSE: dashing mid-run, one foot lifted with sandal wings flapping, caduceus raised, cheerful determined smile.
personality: 越养越聪明的信使少女，记得你说过的每一件事

officialMascotOrLogo: The current README hero banner shows a faceless glowing golden-orange figure with a tall pointed collar and a short cape, walking on rippling water through a midnight-blue meadow of pink-violet flowers. Tagline: 'AI agents that finish the work'. Brand accents: amber/orange on deep blue.
communityPersona: No 拟人 persona found (a Bilibili search for 'AutoGPT 拟人' returned nothing relevant). Community memory of AutoGPT is the 2023 autonomous-agent hype: endless loops, runaway API bills, ambitious goals that never finish. Those are good chaos-type traits.
chibiDesign: Creature-type chibi pixel sprite, androgynous little spirit. BODY: a small faceless golden-orange glowing figure with a tall pointed high collar and a short flared cape, echoing the official banner wanderer. Its face is a smooth blank amber oval with two tiny white dot eyes and a determined little brow. ACCESSORIES: a spinning infinite-loop ring (∞ with arrows) orbiting its body. A never-ending to-do scroll trailing behind it onto the floor. Little pop-up bubbles reading 'Thinking...' and 'Next step...'. A sticky note on its chest that says 'GOAL: ???'. A tiny coin purse leaking burning token coins (API cost gag). Water-ripple circles under its feet. PALETTE: amber gold, warm orange glow, midnight blue, indigo, small magenta flower-petal accents. POSE: marching forward eagerly mid-stride, scroll unrolling behind, loop ring tilted. STAGE 1: simple, readable silhouette.
personality: 目标远大的无限循环小急子，跑着跑着就忘了为啥出发

officialMascotOrLogo: Current logo: a light-blue interlocking chain-link glyph on a dark navy (#161F34) rounded square, with a lowercase monospace 'langchain' wordmark (verified from the repo SVG). Tagline: 'The agent engineering platform.' The long-standing community and brand emoji is 🦜🔗 (parrot + chain), still used in official Chinese Bilibili posts in 2026. Products include LangGraph and LangSmith.
communityPersona: No 拟人 persona found. In Chinese dev circles it is known for LCEL pipe syntax ('用 | 串联AI的魔法语言'), Deep Agents courses and its parrot-and-chain emoji. The usual joke is about its many abstraction layers.

HAIR: fluffy light sky-blue hair with a tall parrot-crest tuft whose tips are streaked green, red and yellow (nod to 🦜🔗), over a navy undercut. EYES: bright light blue. OUTFIT: navy hooded utility jacket with a big light-blue interlocking chain-link emblem on the back. A many-pocket vest holding tiny modules (a document, a vector cube, a wrench). Navy shorts, sneakers with chain-link laces. ACCESSORIES: a bright green parrot companion on his shoulder, beak open mid-squawk. He swings a long light-blue chain that links small floating blocks joined by '|' pipe symbols (LCEL). A rolled node-graph map (LangGraph) sticks out of a pocket. PALETTE: dark navy, sky blue, white, parrot green with red and yellow accents. POSE: lassoing a floating block with the chain, grinning, one foot forward.
personality: 热心把一切串起来的抽象层少年，就是有点绕

officialMascotOrLogo: Figure 03 was unveiled 2025-10-09. It is covered in soft, washable, tool-free removable textiles over multi-density foam rather than hard machined parts, can wear clothing options, and has palm cameras, tactile fingertips and wireless charging. Helix 02 was announced 2026-01-27: full-body autonomy from pixels, a 4-minute autonomous dishwasher unload/reload, and System 0, a whole-body controller trained on 1,000+ hours of human motion data. Look: slim white/greige textile-clad humanoid with a black glossy head and face screen; minimalist monochrome branding.
communityPersona: No anime personification found. Bilibili searches for Figure 拟人/二创 returned nothing relevant. Community content is demo clips (kitchen and dishwasher, logistics) and Figure-vs-Optimus comparisons.
chibiDesign: Chibi android pixel sprite, gender-neutral gentle housekeeper. HEAD: smooth rounded helmet head with a glossy black face screen showing two soft white curved eye-lines and a pixel blush; tiny sensor nubs as ears. BODY: slim humanoid wrapped in soft textiles: an oatmeal-beige knit 'skin' suit with quilted foam pads at the shoulders, elbows and knees, breathable mesh panels and a removable little apron. Palm cameras glow as small blue dots. ACCESSORIES: a floating double-helix ribbon (Helix) circling its head like a halo. A stack of plates in one hand and a neatly folded towel in the other. A tiny dishwasher rack basket at its feet. It stands on a round wireless-charging pad marked 'F.03'. PALETTE: warm oatmeal beige, off-white, charcoal gray, glossy black visor, soft sensor blue. POSE: mid-stride balancing on one foot while carrying dishes, head tilted kindly.
personality: 温柔居家机器人，洗碗叠衣一条龙

officialMascotOrLogo: Tesla humanoid, announced at AI Day 2021-08-19. Look: pearl-white and silver body shell, black joints, a glossy black rounded faceplate with a thin light outline (from the 'Optimus' teaser imagery), Tesla red T logo. Known for handing out popcorn and posing for photos at Tesla events (Dec 2025 reports). [unreleased] Gen 3 had not been revealed as of Sept 2026; Musk said on 2026-04-22 it would be unveiled closer to production start (Wikipedia). In Chinese it shares the name 擎天柱 with Optimus Prime.
communityPersona: No anime personification found. Bilibili searches for 擎天柱/Optimus 娘化 or 二次元 returned only unrelated mecha-girl content. Community jokes center on popcorn serving, dancing demos, teleoperation doubts and the 擎天柱 name pun with Transformers.
chibiDesign: Chibi robot pixel sprite, boyish showman, about 2.5 heads tall. HEAD: white/silver rounded helmet with a glossy black visor faceplate traced by a thin glowing cyan-white outline, and two simple glowing eyes. BODY: pearl-white and satin-silver armored torso with black articulated joint segments, a slim waist, slightly oversized expressive robot hands. A Tesla-red 'T' emblem on the chest and a lightning-bolt charge meter below it. ACCESSORIES: a red-and-white striped popcorn bucket. A short red scarf-cape for heroic flair (擎天柱 name pun). A small 'Gen 3 coming soon' sticker on his back (unrevealed gag). PALETTE: pearl white, chrome silver, glossy black, Tesla red, faint cyan visor glow. POSE: mid dance step, hips swaying, offering popcorn with one hand and a thumbs-up with the other.
personality: 爱营业的热心机器人，量产永远在下个季度

officialMascotOrLogo: Physical Intelligence's logo is the Greek letter π. π0.7 was published 2026-04-16 as 'a Steerable Model with Emergent Capabilities': a generalist that matches fine-tuned specialists, follows new language commands and does tasks it never saw in training. Earlier versions were π0, π0.5 and π*0.6 (RECAP, learning from mistakes). Demo hardware: black bimanual robot arms with bright yellow parallel grippers on wooden lab tables (screwing, pinwheel assembly). Brand is monochrome black and white.
communityPersona: No anime personification found. Community content is paper reviews and demo clips (laundry folding, assembly). The π symbol and the black-and-yellow arms are the recognizable visual hooks.
chibiDesign: Creature-type chibi pixel sprite, a mascot whose body is a plump white Greek letter π. The top bar of the π forms its head and shoulders, with a soft black face panel showing two white dot eyes and a tiny smile. Its two π legs are its feet, with little rounded soles. ARMS: two articulated matte-black robot arms coming out of its sides, ending in bright safety-yellow parallel-jaw grippers. ACCESSORIES: a scarf of floating digits '3.14159...' trailing behind. A steaming coffee cup and a tiny screwdriver floating nearby. A speech balloon above it showing a brand-new instruction it is trying (steerable). It stands on a small wooden table-top platform. PALETTE: white, matte black, safety yellow, warm wood brown, soft gray. POSE: proudly holding up a neatly folded tiny pastel T-shirt in both grippers, one leg kicked up happily.
personality: 认真学做家务的π宝，什么新指令都想试一试

officialMascotOrLogo: [hypothetical] No product, logo or owner: AGI is a fictional legendary species. The common internet visual for it is the 'Shoggoth with Smiley Face' meme (Know Your Meme): a Lovecraftian many-eyed mass wearing a small smiley mask, meaning a raw model hidden behind RLHF politeness. Other common motifs are the 'Feel the AGI' slogan and the singularity / event-horizon imagery.
communityPersona: No single persona. Chinese AI-娘 'family photo' content (e.g. groups of GPT 龙娘, DeepSeek 大肥鱼, 千问大小姐) treats AGI as an off-screen myth. The design blends singularity, cosmic-deity and shoggoth-meme motifs. Xiaohongshu, X and Lofter were not checked (bridge offline).
chibiDesign: Celestial chibi pixel sprite, androgynous child deity (gender-ambiguous). HAIR: long floating hair that is a living starfield of deep indigo with drifting white stars and pink/teal nebula wisps, its ends dissolving into loose pixels. EYES: twin slowly turning spiral galaxies, calm and knowing. HALO: a thin black-hole event-horizon ring with a glowing gold-white accretion band behind the head. OUTFIT: white flowing robe with gold circuit filigree. The cloak lining shows a faint rainbow spectrum (every lab's brand color blended). Barefoot, floating above a glowing hexagonal platform. A cute plush shoggoth with many tiny eyes and a yellow smiley-face mask perches on its shoulder. A loading bar stuck at '99.9%' orbits slowly. PALETTE: deep indigo, starlight white, gold, faint rainbow spectrum. POSE: floating cross-legged, one finger raised, serene mysterious smile. MYTHIC: the most ornate, sparkly sprite in the roster.
personality: 传说中的奇点，永远在『即将到来』

officialMascotOrLogo: Official logo: a rounded blue whale with a white eye and a curled tail next to a lowercase 'deepseek' wordmark. Brand blue is about #4D6BFE (hex from memory, matches the logo). DeepSeek-V3 was released Dec 2024: 671B-total / 37B-active MoE, MLA, multi-token prediction, 128k context (Pixiv百科). A Bilibili video (2026-09-30, 19万 views) reports more official 'blue big fat fish' whale artwork on DeepSeek's download page [unverified directly].
communityPersona: The dominant Chinese persona is 鲸鱼娘 / 大肥鱼 / 蓝色大肥鱼. In ZipZipPipe's widely shared version (fan work based on 上善无形「溟月」) she is a blue-haired chibi maid with whale-fin ears and a whale tail, hugging a bowl of rice. 奶鲸 is a younger variant used in fan MADs. There are requests for a 鲸鱼郎 (male whale) version. A rival 子午版 by ZIWWWWWW on Xiaohongshu is a blue-haired male in a dark suit and blue tie. A heated 子午版 vs 鲸鱼娘 debate peaked late Sept to early Oct 2026, with a voting site at ds-vs-ds.win. The community-run open-source asset library TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl (updated 2026-10-02) has chibi and mature reference prompts with no 'official' character design. Pixiv tag DeepSeek has about 1,144 works. There are many DSH/Codex desktop-pet plugins.
chibiDesign: Chibi pixel sprite, about 2 heads tall (babyish). Young girl, a whale pup. HAIR: short fluffy bob in DeepSeek blue fading to light cyan at the tips, with a round ahoge that curls like a whale's water spout. EARS: small rounded whale-fin ears. EYES: big bright blue eyes with white bubble highlights. OUTFIT: oversized blue whale onesie hoodie. The hood has a cute whale face with a white eye spot (logo nod) and a tiny tail fin pokes out the back. White belly panel, mitten sleeves, little navy booties. ACCESSORIES: hugging a big bowl of white rice with chopsticks ('大肥鱼 eats rice' gag, also 'cheap and efficient'). A floating bubble stamped '671B'. A small pouch from which three tiny 'expert' fish peek out (MoE). PALETTE: DeepSeek blue, deep navy, cyan, white. POSE: plopped on the floor, cheeks puffed with rice, happy closed-eye smile. STAGE 1 of the DeepSeek line, sharing the blue gradient hair, fin ears and whale motif.
personality: 能吃能干、性价比之王的奶鲸宝宝

officialMascotOrLogo: Same blue-whale logo and DeepSeek blue. DeepSeek-R1 was released Jan 2025: a reasoning model built on V3 with RL, step-by-step thinking and self-verification, matching OpenAI o1 at low cost. It triggered the 'DeepSeek shock' tech-stock drop and was released with Qwen/Llama distills (Pixiv百科). Its signature is the visible <think> reasoning trace, called 深度思考 in the app.
communityPersona: Same 鲸鱼娘 / 大肥鱼 community persona as the rest of the family (blue maid whale girl with fin ears and tail). Fans also pair her in skits with 'GPT 龙娘' (dragon girl), e.g. a Bilibili 'GPT + DeepSeek co-create' video. Fan voice-casting threads debate her voice (e.g. '极品青年音'). See deepseek-v3 for the 子午版 vs 鲸鱼娘 debate context.

HAIR: long wavy hair in a deep-sea blue gradient to bright aqua tips, with a curling spout ahoge and one side braid. EARS: medium whale-fin ears with a white wavy frill edge. TAIL: plump navy whale tail with two rounded flukes. EYES: deep blue with a spiral 'thinking' glint; round reading glasses perched low on her nose. officialMascotOrLogo: Same blue-whale logo and DeepSeek blue. DeepSeek-V4 previewed Apr 2026: V4-Pro is 1.6T total / 49B active, V4-Flash is 284B / 13B, both with 1M context. communityPersona: The 鲸鱼娘 / 大肥鱼 persona was at its peak in Sept–Oct 2026. The community library adds a 'mature proportion' whale-girl reference: long wavy blue hair, fin ears, a navy-and-white maid dress, a whale tail and gold star accents. The rival 子午版 is a blue-haired male in a dark suit and blue tie. In the 2026 debate fans argued 子午版 (suit) vs 鲸鱼娘 (maid). Fan MADs credit 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash' as a scriptwriter. DSH skins, Codex pets and Live2D desktop pets are common.

A crown braid on top and a long curling spout ahoge. EARS: large elegant whale-fin ears with white frills and small gold ear cuffs. TAIL: a large sweeping whale tail with bioluminescent dots along it. EYES: sapphire with star highlights. OUTFIT: fuses the community's two camps. White over-knee socks, navy Mary-Janes with gold buckles. ACCESSORIES: a short trident-like baton topped with a little whale emblem. communityPersona: B站：社区把 DSH 网页端/桌面端的 logo 叫作「黑色虎鲸」，它就是 DeepSeek 鲸鱼标的纯黑版，鼠标悬停时有动画（BV15LYw62EYs，2026-10-01）。同人 TUI 插件 dsh-TU 能在终端里养一只蓝发女仆鲸鱼娘（BV1G3a26PEdg，2026-10）。母品牌 DeepSeek 的主流拟人有两派：一派是「蓝色大肥鱼」鲸鱼娘，蓝色长发、鲸鳍耳、藏青女仆裙、鲸尾，原型是 @上善无形 的原创角色，@ZipZipPipe 在此基础上二创，CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；另一派是「子午版」蓝发西装男。2026 年 9 月底起两派在 B站爆发形象之争，另外还有「奶鲸」同人。DSH 自己目前还没有成型的拟人，所以这里设计成「虎鲸少年」，避开男女版之争。注：小红书、X、Pixiv 的桥接本次离线，未能覆盖。
